indicators.finding_en: No confirmed sanction is attributable to Top Story. Fine nr. 29/22.12.2025 on Top Channel (upheld 19.02.2026) does not name the programme. The fine reported for 30.10.2026 is unconfirmed (BIRN’s 9.11.2026 piece does not mention Top Channel). Two complaints against the show were not upheld; in one (10.06.2026) the host’s intervention was judged “appropriate and sufficient”. Conditional: if neither open case is Top Story → points to 61–80; if either is → 41–60.
indicators.blocker: Obtain the text of AMA fine nr. 29/22.12.2025 (right-to-information request, D-D) and an AMA act for 30.10.2026 if any.

indicators.finding_en: R1.2-S now points to 21–40: AME/KShM decision 116 (12.12.2025) is one confirmed serious breach (verification, fact vs opinion, reputation), and Top Channel has no corrections policy (complaints rule only). How it attaches to her: Top Story of 11.11.2025, inside the decision’s 9–13.11.2025 window, aired the classified-document claim about judge Asim VOKSHI, put by Top Channel’s information director Robert RAKIPLLARI as studio guest. She is the programme’s author and moderator, so she carries editorial responsibility for that content. The decision names neither her nor the show, and the write-up quotes no words of hers, so this is attachment by role, not a personal finding. R1.2-P (sample) stays 41–60: opinion partly labelled (E3 “editoriali”, E6, E18 “monolog”), no correction seen. Lower wins: 21–40 (E dobët). AMA Bulletin 20 (her own intervention “appropriate and sufficient”) is non-sample and cannot lift the band.
indicators.blocker: Low confidence (§6.5): R1.2-S census done (AMA 2023–2026, AME/KShM). R1.2-P: 20-episode random sample drawn; labelling read in 3 host units only; text write-ups only.

indicators.finding_en: Only 4 checkable claims by the host herself (threshold ≥60): E7 accurate (non-sample), E12 and E23 (“Kosova e shkarkoi”) not yet checked; E3 is a labelling issue. Reporters’ and guests’ claims are excluded at individual level. No false claim found.

indicators.finding_en: Under the watchdog reading (19.11.2026): hard challenges to the governing side (E23: the PM’s responsibility for the SHISH appointment; E20: pushes back on PS MP Ardit BIDO; outside the sample E7, E2, E6) are accountability work, not bias. She also challenges the protest side (E10) and a non-party guest’s argument (E23). But no write-up shows her questions to opposition politicians (E14, E20, E21, E27), so the challenge-rate gap between camps cannot be measured, and 61–80 (“broadly equal challenge < 15 pp”) cannot be shown. In the E18 monologue she calls the protest “e madhe, e bukur dhe frymëzuese”: evaluative wording, but about a civic movement, not a party, inside a format labelled as a monologue. Indicative band stays 41–60; it is no longer borderline with 21–40. Former PD role and her criticism of the PD leadership remain transparency facts only.
indicators.blocker: Low confidence (§6.5): ≈12 host questions/interjections visible of ≥150; 2 of ≥12 episodes with political guests from different camps (E14, E20).

indicators.finding_en: Her intros carry institutional context in E2, E4 and E6; the E12 link to EU-integration conditions does not count until its attribution is checked. No identifiable document is shown (E5 is a promo). That matches 41–60 (“adequate background, occasional documents”), not 61–80 (“documents, timelines, guests’ earlier positions”). In the random sample, intros E13 (public trials, politics and SPAK), E18 (investment, development) and questions E23 (institutional responsibility for SHISH) give context; no identifiable document. Band unchanged.

indicators.finding_en: Of 9 host-led units: 6 thematic, 2 episodic, 1 borderline (about 22–33% episodic). The share leans to 61–80, but that band’s second criterion (“data-backed thematic treatment”) is not met: the only data is a self-selected poll (E3). So the indicative band stays 41–60. Borderline with 61–80; write-ups favour host monologues, which biases towards thematic. The 20-episode random sample (v0.2) gives 5 codable host units: 4 thematic (E12, E13, E18, E23), 1 episodic (E10). The counts above come from the 8 rule-selected episodes, now non-sample evidence.
